source.reference: GitHub issue #87, Step E; user instruction to continue NEX development, 2026-11-26

original_text: Demonstrate one real, non-behavioural RDO documentation objective through intake, persisted cycle, exact handoff manifest, human scope review, and independent read-only Watcher source/path verification. Record the resulting run identifiers and verification outcome in rdo/STAGE7_HANDOFF.md.
intent: Produce traceable evidence that the Stage-7 handoff pipeline works on a real NEX repository objective without executing tests or NEX runtime operations.

in_scope: Add one factual real-objective verification record to rdo/STAGE7_HANDOFF.md after the handoff has been reviewed and the Watcher has verified the change.

constraints: Documentation-only delivery; no NEX cognitive, decision, or runtime code changes.
Do not execute pytest or any NEX project test suite; test_verified must remain not_authorized.
Do not perform host/runtime actions; runtime_observed must remain unknown_host_only.
Use only the independent Watcher source/path verifier; it must not run tests or arbitrary project commands.
The handoff must be explicitly reviewed before the documentation delivery is made.
exclusions: No changes to the frozen S-01–S-25 specification/register.
No changes to the RDO reasoning core or Watcher verification implementation.
No human-acceptance event as part of this objective; acceptance remains a separate judgement.
acceptance_criteria: The final documentation record identifies the objective revision, cycle ID, work-package key, handoff ID, manifest digest, and scope-review event digest.
The immutable handoff allowlist contains exactly rdo/STAGE7_HANDOFF.md and the approved action is edit_documentation_within_scope.
The independent Watcher report confirms scope_compliant=true and source_implemented=source_confirmed for the changed documentation file.
The Watcher report and changed-file SHA-256 are retained in the run evidence bundle and referenced from the PR or issue record.
test_verified remains not_authorized, runtime_observed remains unknown_host_only, and human_acceptance remains not_recorded.

seed_obligations.title: Record a real Stage-7 objective-to-source-verification run
seed_obligations.rationale: GitHub issue #87 Step E requires a real non-behavioural objective to pass through intake, persisted cycle, exact handoff manifest, human scope review, and independent Watcher verification.
seed_obligations.impact: Without this record, the independent verifier has fixture-level regression coverage but no demonstrated real objective-to-delivery run on the NEX repository.
